title: Descent of affine-limit sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $J$ a small cofiltered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $D:J\to X_{\acute{e}t}$ be a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose underlying schemes are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and whose structure maps to $X$ are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $c$ be a limit cone of the underlying scheme diagram, and $p:c.pt\to X$ satisfy $c_j$ followed by the structure map of $D_j$ equals $p$. Let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $H$ be a functor from abelian sheaves on $X$ to those on $c.pt$, with an adjunction $hH:H\dashv p_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $T$ denote the terminal etale object of $c.pt$. Let $\nu:D^{op}F\to\operatorname{const}(H(F)(T))$ be a natural transformation whose $j$-component is the unit $F(D_j)\to H(F)(D_j\times_X c.pt)$ followed by restriction along the map $T\to D_j\times_X c.pt$ with components $c_j$ and the identity [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $t\in H(F)(T)$ there are $j\in J$ and $s\in F(D_j)$ with $\nu_j(s)=t.

source.place: Degree-zero specialization of lemma-colimit, steps (1)-(3); inverse-image section formula in Sites Tag 0A35 (lemma-pullback-to-limit)

proof.text: Choose an arbitrary étale-object unit representative U, ψ and b of the terminal section.
Compose ψ with the first pullback projection to obtain q over X. Factor q through a stage using the locally finitely presented étale morphism U → X.

Package g as an étale-site morphism γ. The pullback universal property identifies ψ with the canonical terminal map σ followed by p^*γ: its first projection is the factorization equation and its second projection is the over-limit equation.
Take s = F(γ)(b). Apply unit naturality and functoriality, then hν₀ and the representative equation, to show ν₀(s) = t.

proof_origin.place: Inverse-image unit representatives, Mathlib finite-presentation factorization, and the unit naturality calculation

lean.statement: theorem affineOpenSections_descent {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (D : J ⥤ X.Etale) [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom] (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X)) (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p) (hc : IsLimit c) (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ν₀ : D.op ⋙ F.obj ⟶ (Functor.const Jᵒᵖ).obj ((H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))))) (hν₀ : ∀ j, ν₀.app (op j) = (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op (D.obj j)) ≫ (H.obj F).obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (B := p.Etale.obj (D.obj j)) (pullback.lift (c.π.app j) (𝟙 c.pt) (by change c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = 𝟙 c.pt ≫ p rw [Category.id_comp] exact hp j)) (by exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)).op) : ∀ t : (H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))), ∃ (j : J) (s : F.obj.obj (op (D.obj j))), ν₀.app (op j) s = t
